Chapter 1

INTRODUCTION — AGRARIAN LANDSCAPE & CONTEXT

AKSHAYA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGYDept. of ISE
Background of Karnataka agriculture, supply chain inefficiencies and the need for digital disintermediation
The Agrarian Backbone

Karnataka Agriculture Realities

  • Over 65% of Karnataka's rural population depends directly on agriculture and allied agro-enterprises.
  • Key crops span 8 distinct agro-climatic zones: ragi, paddy, jowar, pulses, cotton, sugarcane, arecanut, and spices.
  • Despite bountiful harvests, smallholder farmers face severe information asymmetry regarding current mandi trading rates.
The Supply Chain Bottleneck

Middlemen & Price Disparity

  • Traditional trade flows pass through 3 to 5 layers of commission agents, brokers, and regional aggregators.
  • Middlemen margins erode 20% to 35% of the total wholesale produce value, leaving producers with minimal net returns.
  • Farmers are often forced into distress selling due to lack of direct access to institutional and bulk commercial buyers.
The Digital Breakthrough

Farmer Trades Paradigm

  • 0% Commission direct producer-to-buyer e-commerce engine with full pricing transparency.
  • Real-time integration with Karnataka APMC mandi benchmark prices across 18 regional markets.
  • Holistic agri-ecosystem: Crop recommendation, yield forecasting, and certified ₹1,000 ICAR soil diagnostic testing.
Chapter 2

PROJECT OBJECTIVES — CORE FUNCTIONAL GOALS

AKSHAYA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGYDept. of ISE
Comprehensive technical and socio-economic aims engineered into the Farmer Trades architecture

01. Direct Farmer-to-Buyer Marketplace

Eliminate commission agents by providing an authenticated multi-category trading catalog allowing farmers to list produce with customizable varieties, stock quantities, and expected prices per kg.

02. APMC Mandi Price Intelligence

Embed real-time benchmark rates from 18+ Karnataka APMC mandis (Tumakuru, Yeshwanthpur, Hubballi, Mysuru) alongside MSP data, enabling farmers to price produce competitively.

03. AI-Powered Agronomic Advisory

Implement machine learning models for soil-crop suitability recommendation, empirical yield estimation (tons/ha), and nitrogen-phosphorus-potassium (NPK) fertilizer advisory.

04. Standardized Soil Diagnostics Suite

Establish a 12-parameter ICAR-standard soil testing pipeline with ₹1,000 total package (₹500 lab testing + ₹500 certified digital health card report) tracking sample collections to verified PDFs.

05. Sustainable Subscription Monetization

Incorporate a structured farmer subscription pass (1 Year: ₹500, 3 Years: ₹1,300, 5 Years: ₹2,000) that validates authentic producers, prevents market spam, and sustains operational infrastructure.

06. End-to-End Secure Digital Payments

Integrate Razorpay 256-bit encrypted checkout with server-side HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification for wholesale orders, soil test requests, and annual subscription renewals.

Chapter 3

MATHEMATICAL FOUNDATIONS & AGRICULTURAL ALGORITHMS

AKSHAYA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGYDept. of ISE
Rigorous computational models governing crop suitability, yield prediction, APMC geolocation & pricing indices
1. Multi-Criteria Crop Suitability Index
S(c) = ∑ [ w_i · exp( - (x_i - μ_{c,i})² / (2 σ_{c,i}²) ) ]
  • Features x_i ∈ {N, P, K, pH, Temperature, Humidity, Rainfall}.
  • μ_{c,i} & σ_{c,i} represent optimal mean and tolerance bandwidth for crop c.
  • Weights w_i satisfy ∑ w_i = 1, penalizing non-viable agronomic deviations.
2. Random Forest Yield Estimation Ensemble
Y_hat(x) = (1 / B) · ∑_{b=1}^B T_b(x)
  • B = 100 orthogonal decision trees trained on Karnataka agro-climatic datasets.
  • Each tree T_b recursively partitions feature space x minimizing Mean Squared Error.
  • Output yields expected output Y in metric tons per hectare (t/ha).
3. Haversine Nearest APMC Geodesic Metric
d = 2R · arcsin( √( sin²(Δφ/2) + cos φ_1 cos φ_2 sin²(Δλ/2) ) )
  • Calculates great-circle distance between farmer coordinates (φ_1, λ_1) and APMC mandis.
  • R = 6,371 km (mean Earth radius); Δφ = latitude delta; Δλ = longitude delta.
  • Automatically sorts mandis by logistical travel cost and transport proximity.
4. Mandi Fair-Price Parity Index (FPPI)
I_{FPPI} = ( P_{farmer} / P_{mandi,modal} ) × [ 1 + α · (Q_{stock} / Q_{mkt}) ]
  • Normalizes farmer listing price P_farmer against real-time APMC modal clearing rate.
  • α = elasticity sensitivity factor balancing localized inventory volume Q_stock.
  • Values between 0.90 and 1.10 trigger 'Fair Price Benchmark' badge in marketplace.
Chapter 4

SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE & HIGH-LEVEL DESIGN

AKSHAYA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGYDept. of ISE
Modern 3-Tier Layered Architecture: Vite React Frontend, FastAPI Asynchronous Core & SQLAlchemy SQLite
Tier 1: Client Presentation

React 18 + Vite + TypeScript

  • Single Page Application (SPA) architecture with sub-second HMR.
  • Tailwind CSS responsive design with verified accessible color palettes.
  • Role-specific UI routing: Farmer Command Center, Buyer Marketplace, Admin Suite.
  • Agri-Copilot interactive chat assistant & bilingual Kannada/English toggles.
Tier 2: Application Core

FastAPI (Python 3.14) REST API

  • High-throughput async ASGI request pipeline powered by Starlette & Uvicorn.
  • Pydantic strict schema parsing with compile-time & runtime validation.
  • PBKDF2 SHA-256 salted password hashing & universal session token decoder.
  • Razorpay payment controller verifying cryptographic order signatures.
Tier 3: Persistence & ML

SQLite DB & Scikit-learn

  • Relational persistence via SQLAlchemy ORM with SQLite backend (agro_trades.db).
  • Normalized entities: Users, Produce Listings, Orders, Subscriptions, Soil Tests.
  • Random Forest classification & regression models serialized via joblib.
  • APMC Mandi cache synchronizing pricing benchmarks across 18 regional mandis.
DATA FLOW: Farmer Login (PBKDF2) → Subscription Verification (₹500/₹1300/₹2000 active check) → Produce Creation (Category → Crop → Variety) → SQLite Commit → Real-Time Buyer Marketplace Feed → Razorpay Checkout → Webhook Confirmation.

Chapter 6

SOIL TESTING PROTOCOLS & CERTIFIED DIGITAL REPORTS

AKSHAYA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGYDept. of ISE
Standardized 12-parameter ICAR diagnostic suite, ₹1,000 fee structure & end-to-end report certification
ICAR 12-Parameter Matrix

Diagnostic Parameters Covered

  • Primary Macro-Nutrients: Nitrogen (N), Phosphorus (P), Potassium (K).
  • Physical & Chemical Index: Soil Reaction (pH), Electrical Conductivity (EC for salinity), Organic Carbon (OC %).
  • Secondary Macro-Nutrients: Available Sulphur (S) essential for oilseeds.
  • Essential Micro-Nutrients: Zinc (Zn), Boron (B), Iron (Fe), Manganese (Mn), Copper (Cu).
  • Baseline Reference: Evaluated against ICAR & UAS Bangalore regional soil fertility curves.
Fee Breakdown: Total ₹1,000

• ₹500 — Physical Laboratory Chemical Reagent Testing: Covers wet chemistry reagents, spectrometer analysis & sample preparation.

• ₹500 — Certified Digital Soil Health Card & Advisory: Covers digital certification, expert fertilizer dosages & downloadable PDF.

Diagnostic Pipeline Steps

1. Farmer submits GPS coordinates & pays ₹1,000 via Razorpay.
2. Field executive collects core composite soil sample (0-15cm depth).
3. Partner laboratory conducts 12-parameter chemical assay.
4. State Admin reviews test values and attaches agronomist advisory.
5. Farmer downloads tamper-evident Soil Health Certificate from dashboard.

Chapter 9

SECURITY ANALYSIS, RBAC & TRADING PROTECTION

AKSHAYA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGYDept. of ISE
Cryptographic authentication, Role-Based Access Control, session tokens & transaction anti-tamper mechanisms
PBKDF2 Password Hashing
PBKDF2_HMAC('sha256', pwd, salt, 100000)
  • Zero plaintext credentials stored in database.
  • 16-byte cryptographically random salt per user.
  • 100,000 computation iterations prevents rainbow table & GPU brute-force attacks.
Session Auth & RBAC
Role Matrix: [Farmer, Buyer, Admin]
  • FastAPI Bearer dependency verifies token on every protected route.
  • Universal decoder resolves production JWTs and development session tokens.
  • Strict role guards: Only farmers can publish produce; only admins can certify soil tests.
Trading Protection
Server-Side Inventory & Price Checks
  • Client cannot forge prices: backend calculates total directly from DB rates.
  • Atomic stock deductions prevent race conditions during simultaneous checkouts.
  • Subscription gatekeeper prevents unverified/expired accounts from publishing.
Chapter 10

ADVANTAGES, LIMITATIONS & FUTURE SCOPE

AKSHAYA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGYDept. of ISE
Strategic appraisal of platform impact, operational constraints and upcoming roadmap enhancements
Platform Advantages
  • 0% Commission: Direct farmer-to-buyer sales return 20% to 35% higher profits to producers.
  • Transparent Benchmarks: Live APMC rates empower farmers to negotiate confidently.
  • Integrated Diagnostics: ₹1,000 certified ICAR soil test package enables precision nutrition.
  • Producer Authenticity: Tiered subscription passes prevent fake/spam listings.
Current Limitations
  • Connectivity: Web application requires active 4G/broadband access in rural pockets.
  • Physical Sampling: Laboratory soil testing depends on physical courier or sample drop-off.
  • Mandi Scraping Latency: APMC price refresh depends on regional market committee bulletin updates.
  • Digital Onboarding: First-time farmers benefit from initial assisted setup.
Future Scope & Roadmap
  • Kannada Voice AI: Whisper speech-to-text allowing farmers to trade via Kannada voice notes.
  • Farm-to-Door Logistics: Integrated refrigerated transport booking with live GPS tracking.
  • IoT Soil Telemetry: In-field LoRaWAN sensors for real-time continuous NPK monitoring.
  • Lightweight Mobile App: Native Android APK with offline listing drafts and SMS alerts.

CONCLUSION & IMPACT ON AGRARIAN ECONOMY

Comprehensive summary of project deliverables, technical achievements and socio-economic transformation

SUMMARY OF ACHIEVEMENTS

  • 1. Disintermediation of Agricultural Commerce: Successfully built and verified a full-stack platform that removes exploitative middlemen, returning up to 35% more gross revenue directly to smallholder farmers.
  • 2. Real-World Decision Intelligence: Embedded 18 regional Karnataka APMC mandis, live modal price benchmarks, and Haversine distance computations to prevent distress selling at farm gates.
  • 3. Scientific Diagnostic Assurance: Established an ICAR-compliant 12-parameter soil testing pipeline with ₹1,000 transparent fee structure (₹500 lab + ₹500 digital health report), improving fertilizer efficiency.
  • 4. Sustainable Monetization Model: Implemented tiered farmer subscriptions (₹500/1yr, ₹1,300/3yr, ₹2,000/5yr) ensuring platform self-sustainability while safeguarding marketplace authenticity.
  • 5. Modern, Secure Full-Stack Engineering: Validated production-grade asynchronous FastAPI backend with SQLite persistence, PBKDF2 password cryptography, universal auth, and reactive Vite React frontend.
Farmer Trades demonstrates how modern software engineering, data science and transparent financial rails can empower agrarian communities with better connections, better information, and superior market opportunities.
